principle: Independent facets; no single enum can encode asked/release/grain/attribution/translation/claim status. Source-design evidence, instrument consequence, and interpretation are separate provenance classes. Eligibility is a separate facet from administration/asking; risk-set and sampling-unit evidence must remain source-qualified.
always_forbidden: NO_ASKED or NOT_RELEASED cannot give an ORIGINAL_OBSERVATION for the missing distinction
HOUSEHOLD datum cannot be silently recast as PERSON self-description
INTERVIEWER attribution cannot become SELF without separately authorized evidence
UNRECONCILED translation cannot be asserted wave-comparable
FICTIONAL_FACT or MODEL_INFERENCE cannot become source respondent evidence
No negative/no-effect conclusion from unasked, unreleased or unqualified risk set
INELIGIBLE respondents cannot become eligible observations by demographic proxy, and denominator cannot count unasked as zero
proof_scope: Test positive, forbidden inference, restoration at actual implemented first-reader boundary; for not-built futures preserve typed refusal + first receiver/owner, do not invent executive science.
